This skill should be used when analyzing weekly price charts for stocks, stock indices, cryptocurrencies, or forex pairs. Use this skill when the user provides chart images and requests technical analysis, trend identification, support/res.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Structured workflow and standards for image-based, objective technical analysis of weekly price charts.

- Enables systematic analysis of stocks, indices, crypto, and forex weekly charts using only visible technical data.
- Defines step-by-step process for trend, support/resistance, moving averages, volume, and pattern analysis.
- Introduces probabilistic scenario planning, requiring 2-4 distinct scenarios with clearly justified probabilities.
- Mandates comprehensive markdown reports following a standardized template and file naming convention.
- Enforces strict objectivity: no news, fundamental, or sentiment input; all findings based solely on chart evidence.
- Sets detailed quality standards for completeness, clarity, and analysis discipline.
